_help: Random yearly events for ONE sibling. ages=[min,max]. cond = expression (see README). sib = twin|older|younger|any picks a sibling you can mention as {sib}. Each choice has outcomes; w = weight (number or expression like 'smarts' or '100 - looks'). fx = effects. 'scripted': true events only happen when the game triggers them.
